title: Willing Hands
logline: A village turns out to clear a tank bund or temple ground together. Some people arrived because they wanted to. Others came because they were asked, and their whole day moves differently.

object.note: Object 3 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: The tank carries across: after the argument over its water, a village turns out to clear a bund, some because they wanted to, some because they were asked.

thread_out.thread: From a day where pushed and willing hands move differently to a person who knows in the body what the old heat felt like, and no longer goes there.

requirements: A village organising a genuine communal work day during the filming window
A mix of participants who came for different reasons, willing to speak plainly about it
